name: Hot water fomentation of the baby's soft spot
what_people_do: Press hot cloths or heated water to a newborn's fontanelle (and body) to "mould" the head or soothe the baby.
why_they_say_it_works: Believed to close the fontanelle, protect the baby's head and ward off illness.

documented_by.source: Hot fomentation of newborn fontanelles in Ghana, 2023, Int J Equity Health, PMID 36850018
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Critical review of 31 studies (1983 to 2022): hot fontanelle fomentation is a predominant indigenous home-based postnatal practice in Ghana and among Africans in the diaspora.

evidence.finding: The review describes dangers of the practice and recommends educating mothers; the abstract does not give injury rates.

source.name: Hot fomentation of newborn fontanelles in Ghana, 2023, Int J Equity Health, PMID 36850018

harm_note: Listed with scalp moulding, scarification and ano-genital irrigation as newborn practices that "pose a threat" to the neonate. Scald risk is plain; rates not read.
gaps: Injury rates and burn data not extracted.
